सार (II) m.n. 1. The pith or sap of trees, (e.g. खदिरसार); 2. the essence of anything, the essential or vital part of it, e.g. असारे खलु संसारे सारं सारंगलोचनाः; 3. nectar; 4. the substance or material part (of a book &c.); 5. marrow; 6. strength, vigour, भुजे भुजंगेंद्रसमानसारे R.ii.74; 7. prowess, heroism, R.iv.79; 8. firmness, hardness; 9. the coagulum of curds, cream; 10. fresh butter; 11. air, wind; 12. disease; 13. wealth, riches.
सार (III) m. 1. A man at chess; 2. worth, excellence; 3. compendium, summary; 4. impure carbonate of soda; 5. climax (in rhetoric) (thus defined- उत्तरोत्तरमुत्कर्षो भवेत्सारः परावधिः K.Pr.x.).
सार (IV) n. 1. Water; 2. fitness, propriety; 3. steel; 4. wood, thicket.
